carrier: Hard partition of authenticated persistent leaf witnesses, refining observed last-two-distinct-cut joint R_t
hard_slot_capacity: K fixed; occupancy at most K; symmetric ties may underfill
update_order: z_t=U_t(h_hat_prev; observed_prefix); select S_t; h_hat_t=P_St z_t; predictions from compressed state
split: Maximum-variance fixed feature channel; threshold at that cell mean
selection: Largest positive normalized total-feature SSE reduction; all equal-score frontier ties split together if capacity permits, else stop
equivariance: Exact arithmetic, simultaneous leaf permutation and anonymous cell renaming, no leaf-ID tie breaks
floating_limit: FP64 estimates alone are diagnostics, not rigorous upper certificates
gradient_convention_if_implemented: Discrete memberships stop-gradient; conditional averages differentiable; needs source review

assumptions: Same weights, observed forcing and initialization for reference and compressed recurrence
U_t uniformly L_t-Lipschitz on stated forward-invariant domain containing both trajectories
Actual after-update projection residual upper bounds, with numerical discrepancy separately bounded
bound.vacuity_risk: Products may grow exponentially; valid does not imply useful or predictive

accounting.persistent: K*F features plus H memberships, K counts, last-two-cut vectors and explicit witness mapping
accounting.temporary: Leaf decode, forcing, candidate and GRU/encoder intermediates; selection scratch
accounting.training: Saved activations can remain O(T*H*F), memberships O(T*H); checkpointing not assumed
accounting.cost: Naive greedy worst-case repeated feature scans O(K*H*F); no linear-time claim

diagnostics: A-B-A: alpha1 success control, alpha0 loss control
